selection_rationale.objective: Prefer one dense point-in-time accounting mechanism that is directly interpretable for a three-session horizon, needs no fitted parameter or multi-year cold start, and is not a renamed linear rank gap, announcement-timing transform, or minute-path statistic.

rejected_before_values.reason: Substituting net-profit scale for the frozen roe_change field would be a field-parameter variant of an existing transition operator.

The exact all-component common-support consensus mechanism already terminated at Campaign044's coverage gate; relaxing common support would be a parameterized rescue of that terminal design rather than a new mechanism.
A candidate-specific nonlinear subset of already terminal directional ranks would obscure whether any result came from the new raw-data mechanism or from selecting old components.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_joint_profit_revenue_growth_floor_rank
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: The lower of already-public profit and revenue year-over-year growth is a conservative growth floor: it is high only when both earnings and top-line expansion are strong, reducing one-off margin-only or sales-only signals that may reverse over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: After strict-next-session point-in-time activation and independent forward fill of finite profit_yoy and revenue_yoy, compute raw_floor=min(profit_yoy,revenue_yoy) on the common finite two-field stock-day universe, then compute its same-day average-tie percentile rank.
selected_candidate.availability_rule: Each report becomes usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after announcement_date.
selected_candidate.same_effective_date_rule: Sort instrument, effective session, report_date, and announcement_date, then keep the last row per instrument and effective session.
selected_candidate.state_rule: Independently forward-fill only finite profit_yoy and revenue_yoy inside each instrument after strict effective-session ordering; never backfill from a later disclosure.
selected_candidate.raw_combination_rule: Exactly min(profit_yoy,revenue_yoy) with no coefficient, threshold, clipping, winsorization, sign substitution, or alternate operator.
selected_candidate.cross_section_rule: On each stock day, require both states finite and compute the average-tie percentile rank of their raw minimum on that exact common finite universe.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both already-effective growth states and the resulting rank are finite. Never impute, clip, winsorize, rescale, substitute, or choose a favorable report.
